description: Who a report's email goes to and how it is sent, for a report of any type. Answers 404 until its email is set up, as on a burst's variant that sends no email of its own. For a burst, read `listBurstVariants`, which has every variant's recipients, and `listBurstEmailConfigs` rather than calling this on each variant. On an older report that sends to several recipient groups, `to`, `cc`, `bcc` and `replyTo` list every group's addresses together.

id.description: The report to act on, of any `type`, by its `id` from `listReports` or `createReport`. You can also copy it from the report's link in Rollstack (`appUrl`): it's the part right after `/slides/` or `/destinations/`.

name: getReportEmailConfig
title: Get email settings
